question: Based on the projects identified in City Water Balance Plans, ______ (CWAP) will be devised.
solution:
The correct answer is __**City Water Action Plan.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **The correct option is 2) City Water Action Plan.**
 
• **CWAP stands for City Water Balance Plans.**
 
• City Water Action Plan is a plan that is devised based on the projects identified in** City Water Balance Plans.**
 
• The plan focuses on managing and conserving water resources in urban areas.
 
• Option 1) City Water Area Plan, Option 3) Conserve Water Action Plan, and Option 4) City Water Action Period are not the correct options as they do not accurately describe the plan that is devised based on the projects identified in City Water Balance Plans.
